type: Annotated real UI screenshot sequence, not real-time capture or user study

scenes.title: 01 / DATA DETECTIVE
scenes.caption: A local investigation tool. These are real UI checkpoints, with public/synthetic demo data.

scenes.title: 02 / CONFIRM THE DATA CONTRACT
scenes.caption: Map the columns. Choose dates, number separators and currency. Formats are never guessed.

scenes.title: 03 / START WITH A QUESTION
scenes.caption: The Duplicate Dispatch case totals GBP 4,701.37. Four leads need evidence review.

scenes.title: 04 / INSPECT THE SOURCE RECORDS
scenes.caption: Matching rows are candidates, not proof of an error. Repeated orders and returns can be legitimate.

scenes.title: 05 / MAKE AN EXPLICIT REPAIR PLAN
scenes.caption: The case correction note identifies extra copies at rows 137, 138 and 139. Other rows stay intact.

scenes.title: 06 / PREVIEW THE COMBINED IMPACT
scenes.caption: GBP 4,701.37 becomes GBP 4,593.97: a change of -107.40. Nothing is saved yet.

scenes.title: 07 / CONFIRM THE REVIEWED CHANGE
scenes.caption: Save only after reviewing the affected rows. The preview is bound to its source version.

scenes.title: 08 / KEEP THE EVIDENCE
scenes.caption: Download the included rows, exact edit history and a report with unresolved findings.

scenes.title: 09 / RESTORE WITHOUT ERASING HISTORY
scenes.caption: Choose Original import. Restoration creates another version and preserves the repair record.

scenes.title: 10 / BACK TO THE ORIGINAL RESULT
scenes.caption: GBP 4,701.37 is restored. A working demo demonstrates behavior, not measured user time savings.
